name: gemini
label: Gemini CLI
models_hint: e.g. a current Gemini Pro model
notes: Checked against gemini --version 0.54.4 and the CLI's own bundled docs (node_modules/@google/gemini-cli/bundle/docs). --allowed-mcp-server-names, --approval-mode {default,auto_edit,yolo,plan}, -m and -p all confirmed by `gemini --help`. mcpServers: use `httpUrl` (Streamable HTTP) plus a `headers` object for the bearer token (docs/tools/mcp-server.md). settings.json values expand $VAR / ${VAR} / ${VAR:-default} (docs/reference/configuration.md:65). Tool restriction: `tools.core` is the recommended allowlist (empty array = no built-in tools; docs/cli/enterprise.md, 'Allowlisting with coreTools' -- despite the heading, the actual key is `tools.core`, not `tools.coreTools`); `tools.exclude` is the deprecated blocklist form. `mcp.allowed` restricts which configured MCP servers are connected at all (docs/cli/enterprise.md, 'Restricting tools within an MCP server'). Registration needs the bootstrap settings (no headers/key) in place of the normal ones: register.py (Task 14) swaps in register_files for the run and restores files afterward. Rehearsal 2026-09-28: folder creation and prerequisites pass; the tool-list and instructions-heading checks could not run (Gemini API 503 'high demand' on every attempt). Still to confirm: that Gemini CLI applies the project's .gemini/settings.json (tools.core) in a folder it has not been told to trust; if not, built-in tools stay available under --approval-mode yolo. Rerun RUNBOOK section 9 before using this profile.
